does: Scores for the AI the actions an item would take when damaged (an item's own spells).

evidence.says: its own log string about skipped item actions and spell ids read from the item
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 1 place, CalculateAiScoreDamageItem
EoCServer.dll exports this name; the symbol database finds the export again in the executable at this function by the text constants both refer to
